description: Which diagnosis --REASON_FOR--> service relations may satisfy medical necessity. A relation authored by an extraction model is not, by itself, independent clinical support. It must be evidence-anchored, clear the confidence floor, and be grounded by a deterministic re-read of the source: either an explicit directional clause, or the narrowly governed structured-operative-record route declared in relation_evidence_grammar.json. The structured route requires independently reconciled endpoint quotations, an explicitly labelled diagnosis/assessment section, exactly one service named in an explicitly labelled procedure-summary section, and compatible configured axes from governed terminology. Bare co-location, encounter membership, and model agreement remain non-releasing. Every released service needs such a linkage; where an authoritative coverage policy governs the service the qualifying-diagnosis check is an additional requirement on that same linked diagnosis.
authority: Social Security Act 1862(a)(1)(A) -- services must be reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury
CMS Program Integrity Manual (Pub. 100-08) Chapter 3, Section 3.3.2.1.1 -- the medical record must support the medical necessity of the service billed
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04) Chapter 23 -- diagnosis-to-service linkage on the claim
notes: The corroboration threshold is declared in relation_evidence_grammar.json and controls only the non-releasing corroboration_status. Thresholds, heading grammar, compatibility axes, and accepted statuses are reviewed configuration rather than inline medical-code logic. Loading is fail-closed. source_directional requires an explicit linking clause. source_structured_primary requires an extractor-proposed edge plus independently reconciled endpoint spans, configured structured headings, one unique billable summary service, and compatible configured axes. source_colocated remains observational and cannot release. Agreement-only and retired statuses remain prohibited. The accepted list is validated against provenance.GROUNDED_RECONCILIATION_STATUSES, so restoring an observational or agreement-only status makes the gate ERROR rather than weakening necessity support.
